scripts.copy-assets: npm run build && mv build/_app build/app-build && sed -i '' 's|/_app/|/app-build/|g' build/index.html && rm -rf ../app/src/main/assets/www && mkdir -p ../app/src/main/assets/www && cp -r build/* ../app/src/main/assets/www/
scripts.test:e2e:m4:static: node --check e2e/m4-official-torrents.mjs && node --check e2e/m4-live.mjs && node --check e2e/m4-runner.mjs && node --test e2e/m4-private-state.test.mjs e2e/m4-official-torrents.test.mjs
scripts.e2e:m4:live: npm run copy-assets && cd .. && ./gradlew :app:installDebug --console=plain && cd web && node e2e/m4-runner.mjs
